title: Artifact snapshot checksums and rollback orchestration
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Define a reproducible snapshot format and operational orchestration for rolling forward/back quantization artifacts (FP8/INT8) with verifiable checksums, signer attestations, and automated rollback flows. This ticket covers manifest schema, CI/GitHub automation to compute and store digests, KMS signing of manifests, runtime verification at serve time, and an orchestrated rollback that preserves routing and cache coherence.
technical_spec: Manifest fields: artifact_id, model_version, backend_arch, quant_profile_id, quant_profile_sha256, calibration_digest (sha256), calibration_seed, calibration_tool_version, kv_cache_compatibility_tag, build_timestamp (ISO8601), storage_uri, signer_key_id, signature (kms/signature-b64), provenance_url. Storage: immutable artifact bucket + manifest index ledger (append-only). Ledger entries are signed and include previous_entry_hash to create a simple chain. Rotation policy: when calibration replays produce changed calibration_digest, create new manifest with parent link and set previous manifest to tombstone when explicit rollback requested. Serve-time verification: runtime fetches manifest for pinned model/quant_profile and validates signature and checksum before loading. Rollback orchestration: a blue-green style rollback plan that (1) schedules rollback in the control plane, (2) marks an explicit manifest as active in the ledger, (3) triggers model rehydration on a small percentage of pods (canary), (4) validates goldens, latency and tail-latency budgets, then (5) scales to 100% or triggers automatic reversion on failures. Orchestration will ensure KV-cache compatibility by using kv_cache_compatibility_tag and, if incompatible, will force cache flush and warm-up sequence. CI checks: compute sha256 artifacts for quant profiles and calibration outputs, require manifest signing step, publish manifest to ledger, run deterministic replay harness and golden-set regression tests. For reproducibility we record random seeds and tool versions. For compliance we record signer key id and kms_audit_log entry id.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge manifest schema and ledger writer PR to repo. 2) Add CI job that runs calibration, computes digests, signs manifest with KMS, and uploads to immutable bucket. 3) Add runtime verification hooks: refuse to load unsigned/invalid manifests in private clusters unless explicit override. 4) Add rollback endpoint in control plane and a canary rollout path with automated golden-run verification. 5) Run end-to-end staging rehearsals and tabletop exercise for incident runbook. 6) Ship in runtime-1.24 as opt-in behind feature flag for Dedicated customers, default enabled for Private deployments after security review.
validation_plan:
- Deterministic replay: use stored calibration_seed and tool versions to re-run calibration and assert identical calibration_digest on representative GPU images.
- Golden-set accuracy: 3k prompt goldens across multiple tasks; require no >0.5 percentage point absolute drop in top metric and no >2% relative drop across aggregated metrics.
- Latency/cost regression: ensure p95 latency within 10% and unit token cost within 5% compared to baseline.
- Signing/verification tests: simulate corrupted manifest and ensure runtime rejects load.
- Rollback drill: perform staged rollback in staging and demonstrate automatic reversion on failed canary with recorded metrics and timeline.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema merged and documented in infra/confluence
CI job computes sha256 and stores manifest to immutable bucket with KMS signature
Runtime refuses to load invalid manifests by default in Private clusters
Rollback endpoint implemented and can perform canary rollback end-to-end in staging
Automated golden-set validation passes in canary for a sample quant profile
Runbook updated with step-by-step rollback and key revocation process
decisions: Use sha256 as canonical digest for artifacts (calibration outputs and quant profiles)
Store manifests in append-only ledger with previous_entry_hash to enable audit replay
Require KMS signer on manifests for production (Dedicated/Private)
Opt-in feature flag for hosted until mature; default enable for Private deployments after audit
open_questions: Should we include a compact binary delta for quant profiles to speed artifact transfer?
How long to retain old manifests in the public ledger before tombstoning vs full deletion?
If KMS signing key is rotated, how should old manifests be re-validated by older runtime versions?
